title: Record the Neumann tail below one 16p unit
body:
## Summary
- For every precision from 101 through 200, `(1-1/(16p))^(16p)` is strictly below `1/2`, and `512 p²` splits as `(16p)*(32p)`.
- The Neumann tail is therefore strictly below `32p * 2^(-32p)`, and since `32p < 2^(16p)` it is strictly below `2^(-16p)`.
- At precision 1 the same comparison holds in full integers. The selected κ is unchanged.
